title: Ricercari Notturni
identity: Stanisław Skrowaczewski's 1977 Ricercari notturni is a saxophone (or clarinet) concerto; the listed piano reduction with solo part is a separate purchasable edition, EA432.

evidence.claim: Schott identifies the 1977 concerto, 27-minute orchestral version, and piano-reduction edition EA432.
IMEP library catalog describes a 40-page piano reduction with saxophone and alternate clarinet/bass clarinet materials.
Philharmonie guide lists a shorter 22-minute duration for its alto saxophone/orchestra listing.

gaps: The pianist reduction score was not visually inspected; exact instrumentation may involve soprano, alto, and baritone doubling per a secondary orchestral database.
Durations conflict across sources and versions; do not treat the guide's duration as a correction to Schott's current record.
